_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ine un jo Klondike Solitaire. Teko lako ni kutoa kadi zote hadi kwenye matopeni ya msingi.

Sheria za Mchezo:
- Matopeni ya msingi (F1-F4): Jenga kutoka Ace hadi King kwa rangi
- Matopeni ya meza (T1-T7): Jenga chini kwa kubadilisha rangi (nyekundu juu ya nyeusi, nyeusi juu ya nyekundu)
- Hisa: Chora kadi hadi kwenye taka
- Taka (W): Kadi ya juu inapatikana kwa kucheza

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora kadi kutoka hisa hadi taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha kadi kati ya matopeni
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. nambari pia inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhama kadi zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na ufunge alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya matopeni: W (taka), F1-F4 (msingi), T1-T7 (meza)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi katika zamu moja kwa kuvitenganisha na alama za komma:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ni Wafalme pekee wanaweza kuwekwa kwenye matopeni tupu ya meza.
Vitendo vinavyotekelezwa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa moja itashindwa, vitendo vilivyobaki vitapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Yo ma itiyo godo ok owinjore. Timno onego obed e kind sirni ariyo mag nyukta madongo gi matindo.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Yo ma ok owinjore mar timo gimoro. Ok ochop e rang'iny ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Amri ya kusonga inahitaji chanzo na kikomo. Matumizi: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Hesabu isiyo halali. Tumia nambari au 'all'

action_result.before_failure: Ne otimo {n} gima ne pok otimne maber.

move_result.drew: Ne ogolo kadgo e stock mi owitgi.
move_result.cannot_draw: Ok wanyal golo gimoro amora. Gik moko duto ma ne wan - go koro onge kendo gionge kata mana gik matin.
move_result.invalid_pile: Nying moket ok en kare. Ti kod W, F1-F4, kata T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Inyalo mana loko kad achiel e kar dak mar mise.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Ka ng'ato okelo kad ma ne oselalgo e kar kano gik moko F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ok nyal dar kad mar yugi e kidieno.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Kari ibed gi tableau T{src} pa foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ok nyal dar kad mar tableau e kidieny ma ne ogergo mise. 🔍
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Ok nyal dar e kind sirni ariyo mag mise.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Inyalo mana loko kad achiel kende e sanduk mar waste nyaka tableau.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Ne oter kad e otas mar T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ok nyal keto kad mar waste e wi tableau pile
move_result.no_face_up: Onge kad ma ng'ato nyalo loko ka ok ong'iyo malo.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kari {count} ibed gi tableau T{src} pa T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Inywalo konywa {count} kadibed gi T{src} pa T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Inyalo mana loko kad achiel kende e kind kar dak kod kar bet.
move_result.foundation_empty: Foundation F{src} ok en gimoro amora.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kari ibed gi foundation F{src} pa tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Ok nyal ketie kad mar mise e mesa T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Ok nyal tergi kama ikethoe gik moko kata kuonde ma gibeyoe.

outcome.forfeit: Tuke ne okethore. Gikone, kwan-gi nobedo {score} e karatiche ma nochung'ne mise mag kanisa.
outcome.won: Wagoyoni erokamano kuom loyo tuke mag Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Wuotho! Iwe kelo {max_turns} turn. Alafu: {score} kadibed gi foundation.
